title: TTZipErrorInfoContract
description: JSON Schema contract representing the structured C-ABI error information envelope passed across Swift-Rust FFI boundaries.

status.description: TTZipStatus return code value (0 for Ok, negative for error conditions).

errorCode.description: System errno or subsystem error identifier.

entryPath.description: Archive relative entry path associated with the failure.

offset.description: Archive byte offset where the error occurred.
